newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Firmer European feeds start slow.
newsitem.headline: Firmer European feeds start slow.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started slow with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets $2 to $4 up following last night's stronger Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were offered unchanged to $1 up in sympathy with soymeal. One early trade was reported at $265 a tonne fob Ghent for spot Argentine soymeal pellets.

"Business started slow this morning despite the trend reversed from lower to higher. It seems that buyers want to see another day up before entering the market," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
